title: Woman who secretly returned from UK without informing family found dead in Pune flat
content: Mugdha Deshmukh, a 34-year-old woman who returned to India, was found dead in Pune this week. Her family was unaware of her return and suspected something was wrong when she could not be contacted. They discovered food delivery transactions that indicated her presence in India, prompting further investigation. Police located her rented apartment and found her body without visible injuries.

title: '20 villas in Udaipur, 8 in Alwar': Why IAS officer, IPS wife face ACB probe
content: Senior IAS officer Shikhar Agrawal faces a preliminary inquiry by the Anti-Corruption Bureau. He has been accused of misusing his official position to benefit Goyal Fashions Private Limited. The inquiry includes alleged irregularities in the purchase of villas by Agrawal and his family members. Agrawal reportedly secured financial benefits for the company while he was in charge of industries.

title: Canada sets this condition for international students looking to work there
content: Canada's immigration authority emphasizes that international students may work only if their study permits allow it. Students can work off campus for a maximum of 24 hours per week during study sessions. Violating these work conditions can lead to serious repercussions, including loss of student status. Furthermore, unauthorized work may result in a permanent record of fraud with IRCC and a five-year return ban.

title: Auqib Nabi added to India squad for first three ODIs against New Zealand
content: India has included fast bowler Auqib Nabi in their squad for the first three ODIs against New Zealand. This decision follows an injury to Prasidh Krishna, who will miss the entire ODI series. Nitish Kumar Reddy will remain with the ODI squad before joining India A for a four-day match. The two-Test series against New Zealand is scheduled to commence on November 19.

title: Oklahoma 8th-grader finds 56% of wild plants show antibacterial activity
content: In an inspiring project, eighth-grader Locklyn Raye Ward from Oklahoma explored the antibacterial capabilities of wild plants. Analyzing 24 plants sourced from her family’s farm, she found that 56 percent demonstrated antibacterial effects, but none were as potent as commercial antibiotics. Interestingly, seven native plants showcased promising antibiotic properties, prompting Locklyn to highlight the importance of wild plants while addressing the significant issue of antibiotic overuse.

title: Rohit Sharma likely to lead Mumbai Indians again, Tilak Varma could be deputy
content: As the Mumbai Indians strategize for IPL 2027, they are contemplating bringing Rohit Sharma back as captain while also considering trading Hardik Pandya to another team. With Kieron Pollard leading a revamped coaching staff that includes Robin Uthappa and T Dilip, MI aims for a turnaround after finishing ninth in the previous season.

title: Florida sinks 1,500 tons of concrete off Destin to create 3 reefs
content: Workers are currently deploying three million pounds of recycled concrete drainage pipes to create artificial reefs on the seabed. This innovative project intends to boost marine habitats for local fish species, enhancing both fishing and diving experiences. Positioned between four and eight nautical miles off East Pass, the varied depths of the sites will facilitate diverse marine life.

title: Howrah woman becomes bus conductor to fulfill late father's dream
content: At 59 years old, Dolly Rana has passionately launched a bus service in Howrah, West Bengal, all to fulfill her late father's dream of bus ownership. Amidst the pandemic and increasing competition, she embraced the role of conductor, showcasing her tenacity. With support from local transport authorities, she obtained a new route permit, driving her business forward. Her journey truly embodies resilience and the honoring of a cherished promise.

title: Melinda French Gates says her 2-day rule helps employees know they did a good job
content: Melinda French Gates implements a 48-hour feedback rule for employees to manage work conflicts effectively. This approach allows employees to feel secure in their performance evaluations as surprises are avoided. She emphasizes the importance of giving honest feedback with integrity while maintaining respect. Recently, Gates pledged $215 million to improve women's health and called for better accountability in healthcare systems.

title: Ajay Devgn moves Bombay HC over FDA’s pan masala ad notice
content: Ajay Devgn has initiated legal proceedings in the Bombay High Court over show-cause notices related to advertisements for pan masala. Shah Rukh Khan and Tiger Shroff are also under scrutiny, facing similar notices. The actors must withdraw their ads and explain their endorsement agreements, considering that Vimal Pan Masala is deemed a prohibited smokeless tobacco product in the region.

title: Nitish Reddy joins unwanted list after horror outing against New Zealand
content: In the fourth T20I against New Zealand, Nitish Reddy had a tough outing, giving away 64 runs and ranking as the second-most expensive bowler in T20I history for India. New Zealand set an impressive target of 259 runs, winning the match by 87 runs and narrowing India’s series lead to 3-1. Glenn Phillips played a vital role with his half-century, while India struggled to reach just 172 runs in response.

title: US clears $2.1 billion Patriot missile deal for Ukraine, allies to pay
content: The US state department has authorized the potential sale of 500 PAC-3 interceptors to Ukraine. This deal, valued at $2.1 billion, reflects Ukraine's ongoing military support needs. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy emphasized the urgency of immediate deliveries to address winter threats. The planned delivery timelines have raised concerns regarding the effectiveness of Ukraine's defense capabilities. Zelenskyy has requested a winter support package involving immediate supplies from existing stocks.

title: A mother who had to quit her Rs 50 LPA job, now changing chess scene in North India
content: After leaving her Rs 50 LPA corporate career to support her daughter Shivika’s chess ambitions, Nidhi Bhasin Rohilla discovered gaps in Delhi’s chess ecosystem. She set out to build what was missing, creating an academy, tournaments, and communities for players across ages and abilities. Today, her initiatives span eight states, championing accessibility, inclusion and a culture where chess thrives beyond ratings, titles and competition.

title: Cargo ship stranded in Pakistan for months, sailor's kin high & dry
content: Vedansh Mishra, a three-year-old, frequently asks about his father, Vineet, who is stranded in Karachi, Pakistan. Vineet has been unable to leave the cargo ship since April, with his family seeking help from politicians. Despite appeals to government officials, the family has yet to achieve a resolution in bringing him home. Communication with Vineet is limited due to poor network connectivity and ongoing ship conditions.

title: 'Not doing justice': Yuvraj Singh wants Abhishek and Sooryavanshi in ODIs
content: Former India all-rounder Yuvraj Singh believes young batters Abhishek Sharma, Ishan Kishan and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi deserve more opportunities in 50-over cricket. Yuvraj feels that not regularly considering these players for the ODI team does not do justice to their talent. He also hopes they get a place in the squad soon.

title: Activist Arun Ferreira's arrest illegal, give him Rs 2 lakh: Bombay HC
content: The Bombay High Court has mandated that the Maharashtra government compensate activist Arun Ferreira with Rs 2 lakh. This ruling was based on the violation of Ferreira's fundamental rights under Articles 21 and 22, as he was arrested without valid identification and was not informed of the reasons for his detention.

title: Total construction ban in Delhi-NCR from Nov 5 to 20
content: The national capital region will implement a complete ban on construction and demolition activities from November 5 to 20. This measure is part of a broader initiative to combat rising winter pollution levels. Union environment minister Bhupender Yadav confirmed that there would be no rollback of existing vehicle entry restrictions. Additionally, swift actions will target non-conforming industries and pollution hotspots in the region.

title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donate $1 million to feed 2.4 million New Yorkers
content: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donated $26 million to charities across the US, supporting food banks, children's hospitals, education and animal welfare. Their $1 million contribution to New York's City Harvest is expected to help provide food to more than 2.4 million residents this summer. Several nonprofit leaders expressed shock and gratitude after learning about the unexpected gifts, which arrived as many communities face growing financial and food insecurity.

title: Father's death, a promise and Worlds gold: Manisha Bhanwala's story
content: Manisha Bhanwala defeated American Abigail Nette 8-6 in a thrilling comeback victory in the final to become the first Indian woman wrestler to win a World Championships gold. But behind this historic achievement was a personal story of loss, family sacrifices and a promise she had made to herself.

title: ‘I did everything I could for India’: Poonam Raut on retirement and unfinished dream
content: After four years of chasing an India comeback, Punam Raut has called time on her international career. In an exclusive conversation with TimesofIndia.com, the former India batter reflects on her retirement, the sacrifices her parents made to support her cricketing dream, her 86-run knock in the 2017 Women's World Cup final and the messages from young girls inspired by India's campaign. She also discusses women's cricket's growth and her plans to mentor young cricketers.

title: 4 killed, 2 injured in fire at Delhi shoe factory; owner summoned
content: A fire broke out at a shoe manufacturing factory in Delhi's Mangolpuri Industrial Area, which killed four individuals. Firefighters responded quickly and managed to rescue six people trapped inside the building. Two injured victims were taken to Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital for treatment following the incident. The cause of the fire is currently under investigation by local authorities and police personnel.

title: 'The Time Is Now': How Phillips turned a John Cena moment into India's nightmare
content: Glenn Phillips, during the fourth T20I against India, walked out to bat after Daryl Mitchell was dismissed off the fifth ball of the third over, bowled by Mayank Yadav. He first exchanged a fist bump with opening batter Finn Allen. As he began walking towards the crease, the DJ played The Time Is Now, John Cena's famous entrance theme.

title: Tanker with 27 Indian seafarers targeted in first-ever limpet mine attack in Hormuz
content: On October 29 and 30, two oil tankers were targeted in separate attacks in the Strait of Hormuz. MT LOUISE 1 was struck by limpet mines that caused a fire in its engine room. The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil export routes, connecting the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea. It has faced repeated security incidents since the conflict between US and Iran began.

title: Isro’s NVS-03 launch successful: Navigation satellite placed in orbit; NavIC gets a boost
content: GSLV-F18 carrying 2,250kg next-generation navigation satellite -- NVS-03 -- lifted off from the second launch pad at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC-SHAR) in Sriharikota at 11.51pm on Friday, as scheduled. Around 18 minutes later, NVS-03 satellite was placed in a geosynchronous transfer orbit (GTO) of 37,023km apogee and 170km perigee.

title: Why are paper ballots used for MLC polls? Explained
content: MLC elections use proportional representation through a single transferable vote. Voters rank candidates instead of picking just one. EVMs are built for “first-past-the-post elections” in India in which voter chooses one candidate, so they cannot record ranked preferences

title: Premium hotel in Kochi booked for unauthorised DJ party, liquor sale beyond permitted hours
content: Customers present at the bar during the search operation were reportedly let off after being examined

title: Two friends, same police batch: Karnataka loses second officer in two months
content: Karnataka police inspector Arun Salunke was among the deceased in the helicopter crash in Uttarakhand

title: West Asia crisis triggers payment concern in Keralam’s cardamom sector
content: Cardamom growers voice serious concern over extended delays in receiving payments from auctioneers. Usually, auction houses clear dues to planters within 15 days; currently, disbursements take over a month

title: Actor Ajay Devgn moves High Court against FDA notice over Vimal Elaichi ads
content: Devgn's petition stated that the notice was arbitrarily issued to him as an actor rather than to the manufacturing company

title: The great escape from Theni jail
content: On October 26, a group of 17 remand prisoners hatched a plan to escape from the Theni district jail under the cover of darkness. All of them were apprehended within 42 hours in a massive search operation involving various Tamil Nadu police teams and drones. But the jailbreak has raised larger questions about prison overcrowding, staff shortages, security, and the need for reform, reports L. Srikrishna

title: Jailhouse rock, the ‘others’ in the dock
content: A doctor serving Odisha’s tribal heartland was arrested for allegedly supporting the resistance against bauxite mining. His name, along with those of other activists, did not figure in the FIR, but the police arrested them under a category of unnamed ‘others’. Satyasundar Barik speaks to Adivasi and Dalit communities, which allege the police are using the legal process for intimidation

title: Why is ISRO’s NVS-03 satellite launch crucial? | Explained
content: The mission could help restore the functioning of India’s regional satellite navigation system NavIC; its development began following the 1999 Kargil War, when the U.S reportedly clamped down on GPS data access

title: GSLV places next-generation navigation satellite NVS-03 into orbit
content: The NVS-03, with a mission life of 12 years, is expected to restore the functioning of the NavIC constellation; satellite carries an indigenous atomic clock, along with procured atomic clocks

title: India slams global energy disruptions through sanctions, chokepoints
content: The Minister emphasised that continuous distortions of energy markets through obstacles, sanctions and chokepoints were happening with increasing frequency, greater complexity and wider impact

title: Jaishankar holds bilateral meetings with Foreign Ministers from G20 nations
content: External Affairs Minister Jaishankar met Canadian counterpart Anita Anand in Atlanta on the sidelines of the G20 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting

title: Ex-bureaucrat moves Delhi HC against ‘large-scale’ CAPF deployment during protests
content: The PIL seeks directions to the authorities to disclose details of requisitions made by the Delhi Police and the sanction and extension order of the Union Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)

title: SAD will establish ‘Build Punjab’ department, says Badal
content: “We will allow industrialists to install their own solar power plants which would bring down their power rates to ₹1.50 per unit,” Sukhbir Singh Badal said

title: R. Nishanthini takes charge as District Police Chief (Kochi City)
content: She is the first woman to hold the post of District Police Chief (Kochi City). She was Inspector General of Police, South Zone, before replacing S. Kaliraj Mahesh Kumar as District Police Chief

title: On JD(U) 23rd foundation day, party gives credit to Nitish for Bihar’s development
content: JD(U) State president pointed out that while the term “Bihari” had become synonymous with contempt and neglect before 2005, Nitish Kumar, through his efforts, restored honour and self-respect to Bihar and its people

title: Deeply distressing to see ambulances stranded, students missing classes during convoy movement in Kashmir: Sakina Itoo
content: Sakina Ittoo appealed to L-G Sinha “to explore practical traffic management measures that uphold essential security protocols while ensuring uninterrupted passage for ambulances and minimising public inconvenience.”

title: 17 NC MLAs issue 15-day ultimatum to address ‘coterie culture’, other issues in party
content: Four-hour meeting of the 17 NC legislators in Srinagar comes three days after party vice-president and J&K CM Omar Abdullah expanded the Cabinet, leaving several leaders disgruntled at not being given a berth

title: Failed relationships cannot turn consensual sex into rape: Supreme Court
content: Court distinguishes between consent allegedly obtained through deception and regret over consensual intimacy after a relationship ends

title: Election Commission’s appeals against 16.10 lakh cleared voters raise legal questions
content: The officials who filed appeals against the inclusion of the 16.10 lakh voters may not have had the authority to do so under the Representation of the People Act; according to the Act, the CEO/DEO/ERO/AERO are the authorities with respect to electoral rolls

title: Supreme Court asks Centre to take measures against online misuse of court feeds
content: Solicitor General Tushar Mehta submits that suggestions from various High Courts and other stakeholders have been received and forwarded to the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

title: Haryana BJP MLA questions party’s merit-based jobs policy, warns of anti-incumbency
content: The BJP has consistently projected its policy of providing jobs without political recommendations or bribes as one of its biggest achievements in Haryana

title: Bihar’s interests must be considered in the Ganga Water Treaty: Samrat Choudhary
content: The CM mentioned that Bihar’s rivers hold immense potential for the State, and through the proper management of their water and silt, new opportunities can be created in agriculture, industry, infrastructure, and employment

title: Most licensed traders at Palayam market ready to move to Kalluthankadavu, says Mayor
content: As many as 50 additional rooms have been constructed on the ground floor of the new market at Kalluthankadavu, and all reasonable demands raised by traders have been addressed, says Sadasivan

title: Bengaluru needs long-term master plan for water, roads and sewerage: KBG
content: The Minister said a uniform policy would hold agencies excavating roads accountable for restoration, with clear standards, cost recovery and penalties for violations.

title: Karnataka’s milk price hike draws flak for impact on budget and nutrition
content: Experts warn of increased household expenses and reduced access to essential nutrition, particularly for low-income families

title: SC order on KPSC: Government likely to move review petition
content: The affected officers, now posted in different departments, met the Chief Minister on Friday seeking help from the government

title: CM writes to PM seeking revision of sugar MSP, order on ethanol production
content: The farmers are awaiting an assurance from the Centre even as the cane crushing season has been delayed amidst prospects of cane yield getting reduced this year due to drought: CM

title: 596 polling stations set up for civic body polls in Guntur on November 1
content: In total, 7,75,803 voters to exercise their franchise in Guntur and Tenali; votes to be counted at Acharya Nagarjuna University for Guntur and VSR College for Tenali on November 3

title: U.P. CM prioritised his home turf over 2 Varanasi seats in MLC polls: Akhilesh
content: As per the final tally, declared on Thursday afternoon, of the 11 U.P. Legislative Council seats that went to the polls on October 23, the BJP won six while the SP raised its tally from the previous MLC polls by two

title: Moderate rain likely in south coastal Andhra Pradesh for three days
content: Low-pressure area over Andaman Sea is likely to concentrate into a depression over Bay of Bengal around October 31 and move towards A.P. coast in the next two days, says IMD

title: Andhra Pradesh to spend ₹3,000 crore on irrigation drain modernisation in Godavari region
content: Modernisation of irrigation drains will offer a permanent solution to crop inundation problems, says Chief Minister, adding that 4.68 TMC of rainwater has been diverted to reservoirs during Cyclone Arnab

title: Supreme Court seeks report from ECI on Form 7 misuse allegations
content: Election Commission says it did not accept any Form 7s filed in violation of norms in U.P.; poll officials took prompt corrective steps, it says after Congress MP alleges widespread fraud during SIR

title: Leased forest land at Athirappilly in Keralam to be surveyed amid disputes over blocking elephant corridor
content: Forest department strongly opposes Plantation Corporation, Kerala’s proposal to renew the lease agreement and access more land, citing violation of lease conditions, including engaging private agencies for pineapple farming on the holding

title: Crime Branch nabs PSC additional secretary R. Hari in examination irregularities case
content: R. Hari and P. Satheesh, a former deputy secretary of the PSC, were allegedly in charge of the evaluation process of the controversial exam to the State Planning Board. Satheesh was arrested recently and Hari had been absconding since

title: U.P. CEO directs officials on accurate, error-free and up-to-date maintaining of electoral rolls
content: No officer should share their login credentials, such as user ID, login password and OTP, with any other person, directs Uttar Pradesh Chief Electoral Officer

title: Tasmac revises liquor prices from November 1, links refund to bottle returns
content: Environment cess to be added to the existing maximum retail price of Indian Made Foreign Liquor, beer, wine, liquor from other States and imported liquor; those who return the bottles will get a refund of ₹10

title: BIS organises MSME conclave in Ranipet
content: The programme aimed to strengthen awareness among MSMEs regarding standardization, product quality, certification requirements, and the financial and technical assistance available to facilitate compliance with Indian Standards

title: Orders issued on Vigilance probe into KIIFB-financed land acquisition in Kannur
content: Move follows Cabinet nod for VACB probe based on panel report. Procedural lapses alleged in land acquisitions for Kannur industrial zones, where 4,896 acres were bought for ₹12,240 crore amid questions of due diligence, compliance with LARR Act.

content: Patriot missiles are among the most important weapons Ukraine has to intercept Russian drones and missiles.

content: The party order said a show-cause notice had been issued to Alva seeking an explanation over allegations of her involvement in the incident.

title: 'Don't Know Why I Survived': Christa Pike's First Words After Failed Execution In US

content: The protests were the biggest in a recent wave of demonstrations inspired by those in France and Spain, led by students who have set up tent camps and occupied schools to make their demands heard.

content: The weakness for technology stocks dragged the Nasdaq composite down a market-leading 3.4%, as of 2:15 pm Eastern time.

content: The sudden dip in temperatures, with shallow fog during early morning and late evening hours, had residents reaching for warm clothes as the mercury remained well below normal.

title: Independent Russian Newspaper Shuts Down Amid Kremlin Pressure
content: Founded in 1993 after the collapse of the Soviet Union, Novaya Gazeta was one of Russia's most reputable and renowned organisations reporting and documenting human rights abuses.

title: Trump administration to deport 150 Afghan refugees to Afghanistan via Pakistan
content: the first deportation flight could take off as early as Monday . the broader plan involves routing deportees through Pakistan . at least 80 Afghans have recently been transferred to Louisiana from 34 ICE detention facilities across the united states .

title: How Isro's NVS-03 launch will revive NavIC, boost military independence
content: the successful night launch of Isro's navigation satellite NVS-03 on friday will make India's indigenous satellite navigation system NaVIC or desi GPS up and running again . the success of GSLV-F18 mission is a big boost for India’s strategic forces as they are till now dependent on foreign navigation systems like American GPS .

title: 'My body hurts, my soul hurts': Christa Pike after failed execution in US
content: Christa Pike, 50, survived botched lethal injection on september 30 . she described her injuries, isolation in a prison hospital and uncertainty about her future . in her first public statement since the failed execution, she said she had been struggling with pain and speech difficulties since the execution attempt .

title: ‘Architect of Akhand Bharat’: PM Modi, Amit Shah pay tribute to Sardar Patel

title: End of SIR doesn’t mean freezing of voters list: Supreme Court

title: US-Iran deal on horizon? Uranium transfer, Hormuz reopening in 7 days proposed
content: draft framework for negotiations between the united states and the u.s. proposes transfer of uranium to a third country or reducing its enrichment levels . it also identifies China as a potential guarantor to ensure the implementation and sustainability of any agreement .

title: Omar faces NC storm: Many MLAs upset over J&K cabinet rejig, Srinagar MP to quit
